evidence_class: mocked: an in-process caller, a SQLite catalog file, a local content addressed object folder and a deterministic concept embedder stand in for the session service, the central database, the archive bucket and the embedding provider; a fixed clock stamps tombstones and replays

fixture_inputs.cached_pack: pack-ingest-lock, previews of the recall search results citing lock, beside pack-kernel-feed
fixture_inputs.inferred_lesson: lesson-lock-only supported by lock alone, beside lesson-shared supported by lock, kernel and symbol
fixture_inputs.source_in_search_results: session lock, the top hit of the recall search and the cited source of its records

interfaces: hooks.memory.catalog.Catalog.set_state writes a session_tombstone row in the state change transaction
python -m scripts.swarm_v2.revocation register|catch-up|exposures|lags over a catalog file
metrics: revocation_propagation_lag_seconds per consumer and tombstone, recorded when the consumer applies it

outcomes.observed: case outputs in the a, b and c result files from the focused proof run
outcomes.accepted: a tombstone committed with each session state change
outcomes.committed: each consumer step removes, drops or redacts and advances its cursor in one transaction
outcomes.externally_verified: none; no live catalog, brain or search service was revoked

remaining_limitations: No scheduler calls catch_up; a deployment must run the consumers after each state change or on a timer.
Context packs and derived lessons live in catalog tables here; the brain service has no adapter that registers its packs and lessons with the propagator yet.
A project grant narrowed on a caller is enforced at read time and emits no tombstone.
compatibility: search, record range expansion and the compatibility aliases keep their accepted SV2-IDX-05 behaviour of refusing sessions that are not retained; set_state keeps its signature with an optional clock
rollback_rehearsal: C rewound every consumer cursor and replayed all tombstones after a regrant: reads stayed refused, the dropped pack and redacted lesson stayed so, and nothing already converged changed
